snippet.title: "SPAce" v1.5 Showcase
snippet.description:
"Why not unwind in a special place, built just for you. Relax among the endless SPAce, drifting along stars so new."

"SPAce" is a unique, Myst-inspired collaboration between a husband and wife.  Designed by one and modeled and programmed by the other, "SPAce" transports the player into a surreal spa located somewhere between reality and one's own dreams. 

You can play it for FREE, here!  https://roninyeti.itch.io/space
